label: John 3:1
text: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.

label: John 3:2
text: The same came to him by night, and said to him, “Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher come from God, for no one can do these signs that you do, unless God is with him.”

label: John 3:3
text: Jesus answered him, “Most certainly, I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can’t see God’s Kingdom.”

label: John 3:4
text: Nicodemus said to him, “How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother’s womb, and be born?”

label: John 3:5
text: Jesus answered, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and spirit, he can’t enter into God’s Kingdom.

label: John 3:6
text: That which is born of the flesh is flesh. That which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

label: John 3:7
text: Don’t marvel that I said to you, ‘You must be born anew.’

label: John 3:8
text: The wind blows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but don’t know where it comes from and where it is going. So is everyone who is born of the Spirit.”

label: John 3:9
text: Nicodemus answered him, “How can these things be?”

label: John 3:10
text: Jesus answered him, “Are you the teacher of Israel, and don’t understand these things?

label: John 3:11
text: Most certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know, and testify of that which we have seen, and you don’t receive our witness.

label: John 3:12
text: If I told you earthly things and you don’t believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?

label: John 3:13
text: No one has ascended into heaven, but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.

label: John 3:14
text: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,

label: John 3:15
text: that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

label: John 3:16
text: For God so loved the world, that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

label: John 3:17
text: For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.

label: John 3:18
text: He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn’t believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the one and only Son of God.

label: John 3:19
text: This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light; for their works were evil.

label: John 3:20
text: For everyone who does evil hates the light, and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.

label: John 3:21
text: But he who does the truth comes to the light, that his works may be revealed, that they have been done in God.”

label: John 3:22
text: After these things, Jesus came with his disciples into the land of Judea. He stayed there with them, and baptized.

label: John 3:23
text: John also was baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there. They came, and were baptized.

label: John 3:24
text: For John was not yet thrown into prison.

label: John 3:25
text: There arose therefore a questioning on the part of John’s disciples with some Jews about purification.

label: John 3:26
text: They came to John, and said to him, “Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold, the same baptizes, and everyone is coming to him.”

label: John 3:27
text: John answered, “A man can receive nothing, unless it has been given him from heaven.

label: John 3:28
text: You yourselves testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ,’ but, ‘I have been sent before him.’

label: John 3:29
text: He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice. This, my joy, therefore is made full.

label: John 3:30
text: He must increase, but I must decrease.

label: John 3:31
text: He who comes from above is above all. He who is from the earth belongs to the earth, and speaks of the earth. He who comes from heaven is above all.

label: John 3:32
text: What he has seen and heard, of that he testifies; and no one receives his witness.

label: John 3:33
text: He who has received his witness has set his seal to this, that God is true.

label: John 3:34
text: For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God; for God gives the Spirit without measure.

label: John 3:35
text: The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.

label: John 3:36
text: One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son won’t see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.”

label: Nicodemus, a man of the Pharisees, was a ruler of the Jews
statement: Nicodemus, a man of the Pharisees, was a ruler of the Jews (archon); modern scholarship reads this as membership of the Sanhedrin (John 7:50 shows him among them).

label: Nicodemus came to Jesus by night
statement: Nicodemus came to Jesus by night and said no one could do the signs Jesus did unless God were with him.

label: Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness
statement: Jesus recalled that Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness.

label: Jesus with his disciples baptized in the land of Judea
statement: After these things Jesus came with his disciples into the land of Judea and stayed there with them, and baptized (John 4:2 clarifies that his disciples did the baptizing).

label: John was baptizing at Aenon near Salim, because there was much water there
statement: John was baptizing at Aenon near Salim, because there was much water there, and people came and were baptized.

label: John the Baptist not yet thrown into prison
statement: John the Baptist had not yet been thrown into prison while he and Jesus were both baptizing.

label: A dispute arose between John's disciples and a Jew about purification
statement: A questioning arose on the part of John's disciples with some Jews about purification.

label: John's disciples reported that Jesus was baptizing and everyone was coming to him
statement: John's disciples came to John and said: 'Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, the same baptizes, and everyone is coming to him.'

label: Nicodemus (John 3)
dates: active in the 30s CE (Gospel of John); identified by some with Nicodemus ben Gurion of the First Jewish-Roman War generation (disputed)

label: Aenon near Salim
modern_name: identified variously near Tell Shalem (Salumias), eight miles south of Beth She'an, or at the springs of the Wadi Far'a (disputed)

label: Numbers 21:9 (the bronze serpent on the pole)
author: Moses (traditionally)

label: Thirteen springs in a 4x4 km area near Tell Shalem/Salim
method: field spring count reported by Shimon Gibson (2004), cited in the Wikipedia Aenon article

label: Papyrus 66 (P. Bodmer II, early papyrus of John)
Tertullian.org: Eusebius, Onomasticon (Palmer), entry 190 (Aenon)
title: Eusebius, The Onomasticon (translation)
excerpt: "Near Saleim" (Salim), where John baptized according to the Gospel of John. The place is pointed out even now eight miles south of Scythopolis near Salalm (Salim) and the Jordan.

label: Wikipedia: Aenon (Gibson's springs near Tell Shalem)
title: Aenon
excerpt: This location has numerous springs: I have counted thirteen of them in a small area four by four kilometres and, interestingly, Ambrose in his writings (II, 1432) claimed that there were twelve springs at 'Ennon'.

label: Wikipedia: Aenon (Eusebius's Salumias south of Scythopolis)
title: Aenon
excerpt: Another possible location, which is by Eusebius' description in his Onomasticon (written before AD 324), is at "a village in the (Jordan) valley, at the eighth milestone from Scythopolis (Beit She'an), ... called Salumias."

label: Wikipedia: Nicodemus (disputed identification with Nicodemus ben Gurion)
title: Nicodemus
excerpt: Some scholars have identified the Nicodemus of the New Testament with a 1st-century historic Nicodemus ben Gurion, while others consider the dates and apparent age discrepancy between the two make this unlikely.
